caption:
Figure 1: Comparison of existing restoration strategies and RestoreMore. Existing methods are
limited to a fixed degradation set and typically require joint retraining with historical and new data
when new degradations arrive. In contrast, RestoreMore continually expands a pretrained restorer
by adding new experts using only newly arriving task data.
delegated_acceptance_review: Viewed full final and read eight source-pair observations plus source caption/body analysis. Fixed-set restoration and old+new retraining branch remain contrasted with sequential A→AB→ABC expert expansion. All seven original photographs preserve their degradation/restoration roles; three expert colors, empty future slots, data symbols and continuation arrows remain correct. Added frozen-pretrained-restorer explanation is source-supported; no new task outcome or numerical evidence.
